acceptedAnswer.text: The best time to repair window air leaks in Daly City and the surrounding Bay Area is typically during mild weather conditions, ideally when temperatures are moderate and there's no heavy rain or extreme wind. This allows sealants and caulking to cure properly and ensures our team can work efficiently and effectively. Late spring, summer, or early fall often provide ideal conditions, but we can schedule repairs year-round depending on specific weather forecasts.
